paite: Huan, Aron tapa, Nadab leh Abihute'n a mei lakna uh a la tuaktuak ua, huai ah mei-am a koih ua, gimlim a buak ua, a thupiak louh pi in TOUPA ma ah mei zat louhchi a lan uh.
english: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered strange fire before Yahweh, which he had not commanded them.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA ma a kipan in mei a hong pawtkhia a, amau a kanglum a, TOUPA ma ah a si ta uh.
english: And fire came forth from before Yahweh, and devoured them, and they died before Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in Mosi in Aron kiang a, Kei hon naih mite ah siangthou in ka lang ding a, mipite tengteng ma ah pahtawi in ka om ding, chia TOUPA'N a gen tak hiai ahi, a chi a. Huan, Aron a dia dide.
english: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what Yahweh spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me, and before all the people I will be glorified.’” Aaron held his peace.

paite: Huchi in Mosi in Aron pangak Usiel tapa, Misael leh Elzaphante a sam a, a kiang uah, Hong pawtkhia un, a chi hi.
english: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, “Draw near, carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp.”

paite: Huchi in a hong pai na ua, puanak silh kawm in dainawl ah a zawngkhia ua, Mosi thugen bang in.
english: So they drew near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp, as Moses had said.

paite: Huan, Mosi in Aron kiang ah leh a tapa Eleazar leh Ithamarte kaing ah, Na sam uh khah kei unla, na puante uh leng botkek sam ke un, huchilou inzaw na si kha ding ua; mi tengteng tungah a heh kha ding: na unau uh, Israel innko pumpi in mei, TOUPA chih tak sun zaw uhen.
english: Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons, “Don’t let the hair of your heads go loose, neither tear your clothes; that you don’t die, and that he not be angry with all the congregation: but let your brothers, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which Yahweh has kindled.

paite: Huan, kihoupihna puan in kongpi a kipan na pawt ding uh ahi kei, huchilou in zaw na si ding: TOUPA sathau, nilhchi na tunguah a om ngal a, a chi a. Huchi in Mosi thu bang in a hih uhi.
english: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting, lest you die; for the anointing oil of Yahweh is on you.” They did according to the word of Moses.

paite: Huan, TOUPA'N Aron a houpih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Aaron, saying,

paite: Nang hiam, na tapate hiam in leng, kihoupihna puan inn sung a na pai lai un uain leh zu himhim dawn kei un, huchilou in zaw na si ding uh: na suan zelte uh tan a khantawn dan ding ahi ding hi;
english: “Drink no wine nor strong drink, you, nor your sons with you, when you go into the Tent of Meeting, that you don’t die: it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations:

paite: Huaibel a siangthou leh a siangthoulou leh a siang leh a sianglou na khen theihna ding uh leh.
english: and that you are to make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean;

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi zang a a kiang ua a gen, thupiak tengteng Israel suante na sinsak theihna ding uh ahi ding, chi in.
english: and that you are to teach the children of Israel all the statutes which Yahweh has spoken to them by Moses.”

paite: Huan, Mosi in Aron kiang ah leh a tapa damlai Eleazar leh Ithamarte kiang ah, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat a, tangbuang thillat lak bangte la unla, maitam bul ah silngou tellou in ne un: thil siangthou ahi ngal a:
english: Moses spoke to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons who were left, “Take the meal offering that remains of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, and eat it without yeast beside the altar; for it is most holy;

paite: TOUPA a dia mei a thillat a nang a tuam leh na tapate a tuam a chih ziak in mun siangthou ah na ne ding uh ahi: huchi bang a thupiak a om ka hi.
english: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons’ portion, of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire: for so I am commanded.

paite: Huan, a awm vei leh a liang taklam vei pen mun siang ah na ne ding uh; nang leh na tapate leh na tanute toh: Israel suante lemna thillat kithoihna nang a tuam leh na tapate ding a seh ahi ngal a;
english: The waved breast and the heaved thigh you shall eat in a clean place, you, and your sons, and your daughters with you: for they are given as your portion, and your sons’ portion, out of the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the children of Israel.

paite: Liang vei leh awm vei pen TOUPA ma a vei thillat dia vei ding in mei a thillat thau toh hon tawi ding uh ahi: huaibel nang leh na tapate toh, khantawn a nou a tuam ding ahi ding, TOUPA thupiak bang in, a chi hi.
english: The heaved thigh and the waved breast they shall bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh: and it shall be yours, and your sons’ with you, as a portion forever; as Yahweh has commanded.”

paite: Huan, Mosi in khelh thoihna kel pen ngentel tak in a zong a, huan, ngaidih, a na halkhin tham uh ahi a: huchi in, Aron tapa damlai, Eleazar leh Ithamar tungah a heh a,
english: Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burned: and he was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who were left, saying,

paite: Bang ding a khelh thoihna mun siangthou a nelou na hi ua? thil siangthou, mipte thulimlouhna po ding a TOUPA ma a lemna bawlsakna ding a nou a hon piak ahi ngal a?
english: “Why haven’t you eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is most holy, and he has given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before Yahweh?

paite: Ngaidih ua, a sisan pen mun siangthou ah na la lut sam ua: thu ka piak bang in mun siangthou a na nek ngeingei ding uh eive, chi in.
english: Behold, its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary: you certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.”

paite: Huan, Aron in Mosi kiang ah, Ngaidih, tuni in TOUPA ma ah a khelh uh thoihna leh, a haltum thillat uh a lan uh ahi; hichi bang thil lah ka tungah a hong om ta mai ngal a; tuni in khelh thoihna na na ne ta leng, TOUPA ngaih in thilhih dia kilawmlou ahi kei dia hia? a chi a.Huan, Mosi in huai a zak in a lungkim ta hi.
english: Aaron spoke to Moses, “Behold, this day they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before Yahweh; and such things as these have happened to me: and if I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been pleasing in the sight of Yahweh?”

paite: Huan, Mosi in huai a zak in a lungkim ta hi.
english: When Moses heard that, it was pleasing in his sight.
